social.author: @lathewell@mastodon.social
social.text: Big scene cut off at the back in your render? Check the camera's Clip End. Its default is 100 m, so anything farther away simply isn't drawn (the viewport has its own setting, N panel > View). Fix: Camera properties > Clip End, set it past the far edge of the scene. Don't drop Clip Start to 0.001 to compensate; a huge range is what makes close surfaces flicker. Auto Clip sets both from the scene size, for the viewport and every camera. social.text: Face replacement 🎬 When a stunt is too dangerous, or needs skills the actor doesn’t have, a stunt double performs it. VFX artists then replace the double’s face with the actor’s in post. The traditional pipeline: scan the actor’s face, rig it, track the digital head to the double’s movement, then render and composite it into the shot. Done well, nobody notices. # VFX # Filmmaking # FaceReplacement # VisualEffects # FilmTechnique
